answer: Vouchers who endorse a fake identity lose part of their stake, so collusion spreads like a whisper across an island, never crossing the ocean to the wider economy. Each new agent must stake tokens and pass a proof-of-personhood attestation from two existing members before voting, raising sybil cost to real capital plus social vouching. Attackers must buy and burn stake per fake account, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
